prompts.frame: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production-ready transparent border texture for a pixel Black Clover Roblox RPG interface, one single reusable square hollow UI frame. The attached references are STYLE REFERENCES for the intricacy of the carved metal edging, NOT edit targets. Create an original frame inspired by their hand-illustrated interlaced corner ornaments and layered bevels. Square frame, perfectly front-facing, symmetrical and precisely aligned. Blackened steel with warm antique brass inset engraving and pale ivory metal edge highlights. Each of the FOUR corners contains a compact interwoven clover-leaf knot worked into the metal. Two parallel narrow metal rails join the corners, with small engraved diagonal notches. Keep the central 60% of each straight edge very simple and straight so it stretches cleanly using Roblox nine-slice. The ornamentation must stay within each corner quarter. Strong dark outer outline, controlled highlights, deliberate crisp pixel art shading, limited palette, chunky readable details that survive a small 88px ability slot. Pixel-fantasy game UI craft, like a well drawn high-end RPG equipment frame. The metal has visible depth and little engraved cuts, NOT flat uniform gold lines. One frame only filling most of a square canvas with a tiny even transparent margin. EMPTY TRANSPARENT CENTER and transparent outside; no interior panel fill, no baked-in icon, no text, no letters, no numbers, no layout sheet, no checkerboard background, no drop shadow or glow. Make all four edge rails uninterrupted and all four corners complete. Actual alpha transparency is essential.
prompts.bar: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production-ready transparent horizontal resource-bar BORDER texture for a pixel Black Clover Roblox RPG interface. The attached references are STYLE REFERENCES for layered carved metal edges, NOT edit targets. Create an original hollow wide rectangular meter frame at approximately 3:1 aspect ratio. Blackened steel, antique brass engraved inset, pale ivory bevel highlights. Deliberate crisp pixel art shading and a strong dark outline. Intricate compact clover-leaf scrollwork end caps at LEFT and RIGHT, mechanically symmetrical. Restrained little metal collars immediately beside the end caps. Two thin parallel straight rails across the top and bottom; keep the central half of the top and bottom rails perfectly straight with no central medallion so Roblox nine-slice can stretch this frame into long health bars. Ornamental caps stay entirely inside the left and right quarters. It must look like illustrated carved metal, not a flat gold rectangle. Fine but bold readable highlights, no blurry gradients. Clear wide EMPTY TRANSPARENT opening along the middle so native red, blue or green fills can show through. Transparent outside. The frame nearly fills the canvas, tiny even transparent margin. No fill colors, no text, no logo, no numbers, no background scene, no checkerboard, no glow, no black branches, no extra UI parts. One meter frame only, all four edges complete.
